text: Indo-European.Dangaura and Kathariya Tharu are mutually-intelligible Tharu variants spoken west of the Gandaki River, by approximately 1.3 million people.[9][10] Furthermore, an additional variant of Tharu, known as Sonha, is largely mutually intelligible with Dangaura.[11].
